page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, alongside a bundled 479 GB local SSD storage volume and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance primarily in the average tier for multi-core operations and memory throughput. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU tests fall within the middle 50% category. However, single-core performance shows limitations, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression benchmarks scoring in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth remains stable, with read-only large block transfers reaching 50.63 GB/sec and write operations at 38.88 GB/sec, both ranking in the middle 50%.

For database and storage-heavy workloads, the instance demonstrates solid capabilities, achieving 6.88 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and average performance in PassMark database operations. Conversely, it is poorly suited for complex machine learning tasks; while small 135M LLM inference runs at average speeds, medium 7B model inference drops to the bottom 10%. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is balanced for workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local SSD storage without requiring top-tier single-threaded compute power.
